description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging interface 'LogNode' by wrapping Android's native Log utility, enabling chained logging outputs and customizable log handling within an Android project.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native logging utility to facilitate flexible log message handling and chaining in Android applications.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward log messages to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, and optional exception, then forwards to the next LogNode if present.
